User Story:: As a customer, I want to enter a promo code on the cart page so that I can receive a discount before checkout.
Acceptance Criteria::
A text field and Apply button are displayed prominently near the order summary.

Field accepts alphanumeric codes up to 20 characters.

Field is optional; checkout works without entry.

User Story:: As a system, I want to validate promo codes against the promo code table, so that only eligible codes are applied.
Acceptance Criteria::
Code must exist in the promo code table.

Code must be within valid start/end dates.

If a minimum order amount is set, cart subtotal must meet it.

Error messages:

Invalid code → “This promo code is not valid.”

Already applied → “A promo code is already applied. Remove it before adding a new one.”

Minimum not met → “This code requires a minimum cart value of ₹X.”

User Story:: As a customer, I want promo codes to apply either a percentage or fixed discount, so that I can benefit from different types of offers.
Acceptance Criteria::
System supports two discount types: PERCENTAGE and FIXED.

Percentage discounts apply to cart subtotal.
WELCOME10  might give ten percent off
Fixed discounts deduct a flat amount from cart subtotal.
FLAT500 will deduct the 500 when minimum cart value 2000 is met.

Requirements: Single Code Enforcement and Failure Cases
User Story::
As a customer, I want only one promo code active per cart, so that the rules are clear and consistent.
and want clear error messages when a promo code fails, so that I understand why the discount was not applied and can take corrective action.
Acceptance Criteria::
If a code is already applied, system prevents adding another.

Message displayed: “A promo code is already applied. Remove it before adding a new one.”

Customers can remove the current code and apply a different one.
If code not found — 

Message displayed"This promo code is not valid"
If  minimum order amount not met —

Message displayed "This code requires a minimum cart value of ₹2000." 
The minimum is an optional property on each code record

User Story:: As a customer, I want the discount shown clearly in the cart summary, so that I can see my savings.
Acceptance Criteria::
Discount appears as a separate line item labeled “Discount — Code (XYZ)” in green with a negative value.

Revised total is displayed immediately after discount line.

A “Remove” link is shown beside the applied code.

User Story:: As a system, I want the discount amount and promo code recorded on the order, so that finance and reconciliation teams can trace discounts and customers can see accurate order totals.
Acceptance Criteria::
When a cart is converted to an order, the applied promo code string is stored on the order record.

The discount type (percentage or fixed) and discount value are stored along with the code.

The discount amount applied is recorded as a separate field in the order record.

The final order total reflects the post‑discount value.

Order history views for customers show the discount line item and adjusted total.

Finance reports can query discount details from the order record for reconciliation.
